thread:
Alex Chen: heads up — support saw a customer report where a single streaming request that hit a toolcall was truncated, resumed, and ended up showing double usage in the console (provisional + confirmed). anyone familiar with this flow? :thinking:

Maria Gomez: can you paste the logs / request ids? reconnect or server retry?

Alex Chen: reconnect from client. redacted snippet:
```
2026-03-10T15:20:12Z INFO stream:start session=SID-abc123 route=router-a
2026-03-10T15:20:15Z WARN stream:recv eof toolcall_start id=TID-444
2026-03-10T15:20:16Z INFO router:fallback session=SID-abc123 -> SID-def456
2026-03-10T15:20:17Z INFO toolcall:start id=TID-444 resume=true prefix_len=178
2026-03-10T15:20:17Z INFO billing:provisional tokens=432 request_id=RID-9001
2026-03-10T15:20:20Z INFO billing:confirmed tokens=598 request_id=RID-9001
```

Samir Patel: toolcall id kept the same but session rotated. looks like provisional emitted on resume and confirmed later summed prefix+suffix without dedupe — double-counting the prefix.

Kevin Liu: that matches my memory: ledger dedupe key is session_id + toolcall_id; if session changes, dedupe misses. resume flow intentionally allowed session rotation for sticky clients.

Anya Kaur: historically we scoped dedupe to session to avoid cross-session poisoning. but this case where toolcall_id persists across sessions breaks things.

Maria Gomez: low-friction fix: prefer dedupe by request_id when present (request_id is supplied by clients). fallback to existing behavior for older clients.

Kevin Liu: request_id patch helps, but not all clients send it. alternative quick mitigation: when resume is detected and session differs, mark provisional as transient and don't surface provisional to the Console charts until a confirmed comes in. ledger will still record provisionals (no card charge) but UI won't confuse customers.

Samir Patel: that hides the symptom; need backend reconciliation to avoid any ledger-level double counting should we ever flip provisional to confirmed incorrectly. my plan: store prefix_range + prefix_hash per provisional. on confirmed, compute intersection with stored prefixes and subtract overlap before committing confirmed.tokens. watch out for concurrent resumes and prefix eviction.

Anya Kaur: small event change request: add provisional.origin tag (values like resume|session-rotate) so querying affected flows is easier.

Maria Gomez: here's a quick query to surface candidates in staging:
```
SELECT b.request_id, b1.session_id as s1, b2.session_id as s2, b1.tokens as provisional_tokens, b2.tokens as confirmed_tokens
FROM billing_events b1
JOIN billing_events b2 ON b1.request_id = b2.request_id
WHERE b1.type='provisional' AND b2.type='confirmed' AND b1.created_at < b2.created_at
AND (b1.session_id != b2.session_id)
LIMIT 200;
```

Kevin Liu: timeline: push Console hide as hotfix (need oncall signoff), add provisional.origin tag and telemetry. backend dedupe/prefix-overlap algorithm in next sprint with Samir owning RFC.

Samir Patel: I'll sketch the algorithm: store (toolcall_id, prefix_hash, prefix_length, created_at) per provisional. On confirmed, try to match by request_id; if missing, compute overlap by matching prefix_hash or by token-range intersection heuristic. Deduct overlapped tokens and mark provisional as reconciled to avoid future matches. Handle concurrent resumes by optimistic locking.

Alex Chen: deploy window?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-10 16:00-17:00 UTC. non-critical hotfixes require oncall approval.

Anya Kaur: I'll add a billing dashboard alert tile that lists request_ids which have provisional+confirmed within 30s with different sessions, visible to support and billing.

Maria Gomez: Kevin will open PR for Console hide + event tag. Samir will write RFC for overlap reconciliation. Anya will add the dashboard tile. Alex will inform support of mitigation steps.

Alex Chen: thanks all. we'll monitor for recurrences and prioritize full dedupe fix next week. :pray:
